The hp48 is much more sophisticated

press and hold [ON].
press and release [A] and [F].

if you now release [ON] you will coldboot the operating system (memory clear). You also get a prompt "Try to recover memory?".

If you realise you do not want to erase the memory, before releasing [ON] you press and release [B] and then release [ON]. Pressing and releasing [B] aborts the coldboot procedure.

[ON][SPC] puts the calculator in "coma mode". All functions off to conserve memory and the only thing powered is the main ram,which is powered from an emergency capacitor.
